notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Two coral atolls with bright white sand, many palms and mowed grass, far less forested or hilly than the other Indian Ocean island territory nearby.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A unique car with a snorkel at the front right and the edges of the truck bed visible is found on the main island.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A white car with its rear edges visible is found in the village area; the car may be fully blurred.

notes.subject: street
notes.text: The village has cross-hatched brick pavement.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: The runway is the widest paved road on the islands, with mowed grass on both sides and a follow car.

notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: Many trekkers walk the coast on white sand with the ocean on one side and palms on the other.

notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: Direction Island has noticeably more beach litter, such as bricks, styrofoam and dead coral, with the trekker also walking between palms inland.

notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: The inland trekker on Horsburgh Island shows dry yellow grass and sparser vegetation.

notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: Boat coverage includes a medium boat with large seating from the main island to the village, a small boat with black bars at the rear in the north, and a small dark grey boat in the south.
